name: generated-playwright-outcomes
goal: Record generated app Playwright outcomes under their declared case identities.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Generated apps configure page cases but install no reporter that writes their Playwright outcomes for Harness verification.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing app generator case checked discovery and scenarios but not runner outcome production. Extend that case with the generated reporter and status, retry and title expectations.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: The existing generator case failed because the generated Playwright configuration does not install a case reporter.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: The generated app installs the shared case reporter; its Playwright callback writes declared titles, attempts and observed outcomes.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged generator case passed at 7a4aa4a35a after failing on the test-only commit, using the same environment.

steps.title: Reintroduce and restore the missing reporter in the existing generator case.
steps.evidence: Mutant 9ad293cb34 failed capture fc1e0d77c85c; restored 7ce145771b passed with the same tree as a037516b06.

steps.title: Measure changed templates and retain their normal workloads.
steps.evidence: At a037516b06, source bytes/lines/complexity/dependencies: project tests 9259/218/12/5, project 8271/223/10/11, guidance 18267/145/9/3. Capture 98aab9d9f393 retains normal workloads and whole-worker RSS; modules emit no separate artifacts.

steps.title: Inspect a freshly generated app and its strict case inventory.
steps.evidence: A fresh CLI app contains the reporter and three registered initial-page cases; strict registry still reports 195 unrelated atom and script gaps. Browser execution remains pending.

steps.title: Run static checks and build in the fresh generated app.
steps.evidence: The disposable generated app passed Svelte typecheck, lint, audit, formatting and build with its own installed dependencies. Its strict registry still reports 195 coverage gaps; no browser ran.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
